description: Rough lifetime sales and net revenue (low/medium/high) for up to 50 Steam games, computed exactly like Markan's spreadsheet add-ins: reviews x a release-year multiplier (Boxleiter method), and list price x sales x a factor for refunds, regional pricing, discounts, tax and Steam's cut. Estimates, not reported figures.
